audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers treat Mel's W Rebuttal as something that only reflects Blinding Dart (content wants.foe[1], late).
audit.why: Rebuttal reflects hostile projectiles, and ordinary ranged champion basic attacks are projectiles for this purpose. Teemo is not on the wiki's bypass list (Azir, Senna, Thresh, Vel'Koz, Aphelios Severum, Zeri Living Battery, turrets). So Rebuttal blanks Teemo's autos — his actual damage — not merely his Q.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal reflects Teemo's basic attacks as well as Blinding Dart, so it blanks his entire DPS for its duration; wait it out rather than dumping autos into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real cooldown numbers anywhere; the cooldown section named only Solar Snare in vague terms.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26s and Solar Snare is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Rebuttal at rank 1 is the single longest cooldown in the lane and is the only thing that blanks Teemo's autos — that is the trade window, and it is a full 38 seconds wide early.
audit.corrected: Track Rebuttal, not just Solar Snare: 38s at rank 1 means she can only blank one Teemo commit per ~38 seconds. Open trades the moment it drops.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.tldr and full.winCon both instructed the player to "blind his Solar Snare".
audit.why: Blind causes basic attacks to miss; it has no effect on ability casts. Solar Snare is an ability, so it cannot be blinded. The advice was mechanically impossible and would get a player rooted while they held Q for the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: Dodge Solar Snare (it is a projectile you sidestep); save Blinding Dart for her loaded Searing Brilliance auto.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance was described only as generic 'Overwhelm stacking'; the auto-attack payload was never named.
audit.why: Searing Brilliance loads Mel's NEXT BASIC ATTACK with three bonus projectiles per ability cast, up to nine. That loaded auto is the burst, and because it is a basic attack Blinding Dart erases it outright — which is exactly why Teemo's Q has value in a lane against a mage.
audit.corrected: Her combo tell is the ability cast that loads the auto; blind the follow-up attack, not the ability.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.win gave Mel 5 of 7 stages while Teemo wins the matchup, and it contradicted full.phases, which gave Teemo levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items.
audit.why: The two layers cannot both be right. Levels 2-3 are Teemo's: Blinding Dart is online, his on-hit DPS beats a level-2/3 mage, and Rebuttal at rank 1 covers only one commit per 38s. Levels 4-5 onward genuinely swing back to Mel as Solar Snare's cooldown falls and Rebuttal ranks up, so those stages were left with her.
audit.corrected: win[1] and win[2] moved to Teemo; the chart now reads Mel / Teemo / Teemo / Mel / Teemo / Mel / Mel, which matches both the win rate and the full layer.

audit.why: 53.25% over 492 games is the figure already carried in the data; content.late cites '53% win rate' consistently.

edits.after: Radiant Volley outranges your autos 950 to 500 and stacks Overwhelm before Blinding Dart can reach her — farm at max range and accept losing the first trade.

edits.after: Blinding Dart eats the loaded Searing Brilliance auto, and Rebuttal is a 38s cooldown at rank 1 — one blanked trade per minute is not enough for her.

edits.after: Full kit online: your on-hit DPS beats hers in any exchange Rebuttal is not covering, so open trades the moment that barrier drops or she walks it forward.

edits.before: Land Blinding Shot before stepping into her Q volley arc — a blind negates her auto-stacking and breaks her Overwhelm rhythm
edits.after: Land Blinding Dart before stepping into her Q volley arc — a blind negates her auto-stacking and breaks her Overwhelm rhythm

edits.before: Hold W Rebuttal for your Blinding Dart and reflect it back into your face to turn your best spell into her damage
edits.after: Hold W Rebuttal for your auto rhythm — it reflects basic attacks too, blanking your whole DPS for its duration

edits.before: Mel's Blackfire Torch and second item make her a legitimate kill threat: her snare-volley-execute loop deletes you before Toxic Shot's DoT can matter, and W Rebuttal turns any Blinding Shot you fire into free damage for her. Your win condition at this stage is the split lane, not the duel — shroom every brush between you and her, bait the E snare with a decoy step and then W out, and never get caught in the open under two items. The 53% win rate comes from Teemo's ability to deny her Overwhelm stacking through shroom zone control and blind-gating her autos; if she stacks freely and hits the execute threshold, you are dead regardless of your HP bar.
edits.after: Mel's Blackfire Torch and second item make her a legitimate kill threat: her snare-volley-execute loop deletes you before Toxic Shot's DoT can matter, and W Rebuttal reflects your autos as well as Blinding Dart, blanking your DPS outright. Your win condition at this stage is the split lane, not the duel — shroom every brush between you and her, bait the E snare with a decoy step and then W out, and never get caught in the open under two items. notes: Full layer refers to Mel as "he/his" throughout (phases, breakdown, ahead, report) — she is female. These are template artifacts, not matchup errors, so I did not spend the length budget on pronoun-only edits; a global pronoun pass on teemo.full.js would fix them cheaply. Separately: teemo.json kit derives a "knockup" flag on Noxious Trap (R) — the mushroom slows, it does not displace. That derived flag is a false positive and _missing-interactions.json propagates it as a "knockup-enabler" rule into several Teemo matchups (nautilus, poppy, malphite, singed, gnar, darius, riven, rumble). I ignored it everywhere and recommend suppressing that rule for Teemo.
